# `acosh`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns inverse hyperbolic cosine of `expr`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
acosh(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- acosh, example 1
> SELECT acosh(1);
0.0
```

```sql
-- acosh, example 2
> SELECT acosh(0);
NaN
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
